examples.arabic: قال احمد ممتاز لنذهب الى البحر ثم نخطط لرحلة طويلة في الشهر القادم
examples.english: Ahmed said "Excellent let's go to the sea then we will plan a long trip next month"
examples.transliteration: qāla aḥmadu mumtāzun linadhhab ilā l-baḥri thumma nukhaṭṭiṭu liriḥlatin ṭawīlatin fī ash-shahri l-qādimi

examples.arabic: ثم سالني فجاة عن خططي لحضور حفل زفاف ابن اخي الاسبوع القادم
examples.english: Then he suddenly asked me about my plans to attend my nephew's wedding next week.
examples.transliteration: Thumma sa'alanī faj'atan ʿan khuṭaṭī li-ḥuḍūr ḥafl zifāf ibn akhī al-usbūʿ al-qādim.

examples.english: I felt joy and will visit them again next week
examples.transliteration: Sha'artu bil-farahi wa sa'azuruhum al-usbua al-qadim

examples.arabic: بعد مرور ساعة من النقاش، قالت ليلى: "شكراً جزيلاً لكما على تفهمكما، وإلى اللقاء في الاجتماع القادم."
examples.english: After an hour of discussion, Layla said: "Thank you both very much for your understanding, and goodbye until the next meeting."
examples.transliteration: Ba'da mururi sa'atin min an-niqash, qalat Layla: "Shukran jazilan lakuma 'ala tafahhumikuma, wa ila al-liqa'i fi al-ijtima' al-qadim."
